ud3.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
ud3.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Pilindavaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarati.
ud3.6:1.4: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
ud3.6:1.5: āyasmā bhante Pilindavaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācaratī 'ti.
ud3.6:2.1: atha kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
ud3.6:2.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena Pilindavacchaṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantehi:
ud3.6:2.4: evam bhante 'ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato paṭissutvā yen' āyasmā Pilindavaccho ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Pilindavacchaṃ etad avoca:
ud3.6:3.1: evam āvuso 'ti kho āyasmā Pilindavaccho tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmantaṃ Pilindavacchaṃ bhagavā etad avoca:
ud3.6:3.2: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Vaccha bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarasī 'ti.
ud3.6:4.1: atha kho bhagavā Pilindavacchassa pubbenivāsaṃ manasikaritvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
ud3.6:4.2: mā kho tumhe bhikkhave Vacchassa bhikkhuno ujjhāyittha.
ud3.6:4.3: na bhikkhave Vaccho dosantaro bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācarati.
ud3.6:4.4: Vacchassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañca jātisatāni abbokiṇṇāni brāhmaṇakule paccājātāni:
ud3.6:4.6: ten' āyaṃ Vaccho bhikkhū vasalavādena samudācaratī 'ti.
ud3.6:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud3.6:6.1: yamhi na māyā vattati na māno,
ud3.6:6.4: so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū
